about: The exit rules of nat.egresses (Wave 3 contract 2.8.1) and the conversion of the legacy NAT keys (2.8.2). Each case has a value and either the refusal code (the first rule it breaks) or the normalised value; each legacy row has the legacy values, the exits and dropped values legacy_egresses gives, and whether the exits pass the rules (and, where it differs, the form revision 0018 keeps in its status row, from: a number canonical JSON refuses as its text). Read by db/tests/test_egress.py and the web mirror's test (egress-model.test.ts).
